summary: Of 6 tests across 12 nightly runs, 3 are flaky and 1 is broken. Each flaky test has a different cause: an async wait, an environment-specific network dependency, and shared test data. The price filter test has failed in every run since run 9 with a low flip rate, which is the signature of a product regression, not flakiness.

insights.test: checkout.spec.ts > guest can apply a coupon
insights.likely_root_cause: The test clicks a build-generated CSS class after a fixed 3 second wait. When the page renders slowly, the click times out at 10 seconds.
insights.evidence: 72.7% flip rate; every failure is the same locator timeout; duration varies by 25.6%; failures appear on both environments.
insights.how_to_confirm: Run it 20 times with Playwright --repeat-each=20, then again with CPU throttling; the failure rate should rise under load.
insights.recommended_fix: Use a data-testid or role locator and a web-first assertion instead of waitForTimeout.

insights.likely_root_cause: Every failure happened on staging-b, where the connection to the refunds sandbox times out.
insights.evidence: failures_by_env: staging-b 4/4 runs failed, staging-a 0; 111.8% duration variation caused by 30 second timeouts; a single error signature.
insights.how_to_confirm: Call the refunds sandbox health endpoint from a staging-b agent and from a staging-a agent.
insights.recommended_fix: Fix the network route from staging-b to the refunds sandbox, and add a dependency health check that skips refund tests with a clear reason when the sandbox is down.

insights.test: checkout.spec.ts > registered user checks out with saved card
insights.likely_root_cause: The fixture creates users with predictable emails that collide with leftovers from earlier runs.
insights.evidence: Every failure is a 409 'user already exists'; duration is stable (5.3%), which rules out timing.
insights.how_to_confirm: Run the suite twice in a row against the same environment without cleanup; the second run should fail.
insights.recommended_fix: Generate a unique email per run and delete the user in teardown.

insights.likely_root_cause: A consistent failure since run-009 (0 results for 50-100 AED) points to a regression in the search price filter or its index.
insights.evidence: Flip rate is only 9.1%: it passed for 8 runs, then failed in all 4 runs from run-009.
insights.how_to_confirm: Query the search API for the 50-100 AED range directly; bisect the changes merged before run-009.
insights.recommended_fix: Treat this as a product defect: raise a bug, and re-index search on staging if the index is stale.

patterns: Failures are spread across different root causes; there is no systemic framework problem.
Environment-specific failures cluster on staging-b, so environment health should be part of the nightly report.
Two of the four problems are test-design issues (waits, data) that review rules could prevent.
prevention: Block waitForTimeout and Thread.sleep with lint rules in CI.
Have every fixture generate unique data and clean up after itself.
Track flip rate weekly and quarantine tests above 30% automatically, with an owner and a fix-by date.
Run a dependency health check at the start of each pipeline and tag failures it explains as environment issues.
